narrative.offerRewardText:
adventurer, your successful re-engineering of the cauldrons is a tremendous victory for us!

<The commander clears his throat and begins to bellow loudly.>

Let all within my presence hear: for service to the Kingdom of Stormwind and to the Alliance above and beyond the call of duty - in the face of overwhelming odds and incredible danger, might I add - I give adventurer this, and I extend upon his our undying gratitude as a true hero of the Alliance. Cheers, I say!

quests.objectiveText: Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade's base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent. Place the Scourge banner at the camp, and then return to Hig

quests.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Felstone Field
quests.objectiveText: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there.

quests.name: Return to the Bulwark
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
quests.objectiveText: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to the Bulwark
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
quests.objectiveText: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to the Bulwark
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Gahrron's Withering
quests.objectiveText: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.
